title: PAR-134 MLEADER CMC flags and reserved-index retention
mode: generated AC1024/AC1032 DWG object-vector and DXF loss-guard fast slice
scope: Retain R2004+ CMC flags, reserved index, and provenance across MLEADER leader-line, annotation-context, and entity-level colors
Preserve supported C0-C3 optional color/book names, including flagged-empty strings, on DWG rewrite
Refuse malformed CMC provenance and unavailable detached strings before DWG output
Refuse unsupported source methods and unrepresentable CMC metadata before scalar-only MLEADER DXF output

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The generic R2004+ CMC representation has a reserved leading BS index of zero, packed BL method/value, and RC flags for optional color-name/book TV strings. ODA identifies the MLEADER entity and embedded annotation-context color slots as CMC; it does not define additional semantics for unknown CMC methods.

localSource.finding: The seven MLEADER color slots previously retained normalized colors, methods, and optional names but dropped the raw CMC flags/index. The scalar-only DXF writer also did not reject a retained unsupported source method or a flagged-empty optional name.

productionSummary: Append raw flags, reserved index, and metadata-presence fields for the per-line color, three embedded context colors, and three entity-level colors; copy/reset paths preserve or clear provenance as appropriate.
Capture CMC flags/index through bounded parsing and clear DWG-only provenance when the corresponding DXF scalar color group is updated.

Replay supported source flags through DWG encoding, including flagged-empty strings; preflight index, flag domain, string/flag agreement, method/scalar agreement, and detached R2007+ string storage before common-prefix output.
Extend scalar-only MLEADER DXF loss checks to refuse RGB/name/book metadata, flagged-empty names, nonzero indices, and source CMC methods that do not match their scalar C0/C1/C3 projection.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: Appended fields increase DRW_MLeaderLeaderLine, DRW_MLeaderAnnotContext, and DRW_MLeader object sizes; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.dwgVectors: Generated AC1024/AC1032 vectors exercise flags/index across the MLEADER leader line, text/background/block context, and leader/text/block entity colors. A flagged-empty color-name vector checks source replay and parser retention.
generatedControls.wireWalk: An independent cursor checks the reserved index, method/value, raw flags, optional strings, and subsequent MLEADER fields; production parsing also checks the following-handle sentinel.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Tests cover parser copy, assignment, reset, and DWG rewrite of flagged-empty metadata.
generatedControls.failClosed: DWG controls reject nonzero reserved index, unknown flags, unflagged names, unsupported C5 rewrite, and flagged-empty names without a detached stream before emitting bytes. DXF controls reject C5 and flagged-empty CMC across scalar-only fields before publication.

validation.strictBuild: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_wave1_tests libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4
validation.diffCheck: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.cpp src/drw_entities.h src/libdxfrw.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp tests/wave1_tests.cpp

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors establish local wire/parser/writer consistency, not independent MLEADER producer semantics.
Unknown CMC methods remain unqualified and fail closed; this slice does not define C4-C8 payload semantics or class-specific HATCH gradient behavior.
No persistent drawing fixture, external producer, native CAD application, full suite, or platform qualification was run.
No support claim was promoted. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
